param.reserverunpath: Whether to preserve the execution directory

fifo.accessdenied: The Runner does not have permission to access the interaction pipe
fifo.interrupted: The interaction pipe operation was interrupted
fifo.invalidpipe: The target is not a valid interaction pipe or was replaced while being opened
fifo.ioerror: An I/O error occurred while accessing the interaction pipe
fifo.missingpath: The interaction pipe path does not exist
fifo.nativeunavailable: The Runner cannot use the native pipe interface
fifo.noreader: No process is reading from the interaction pipe, so the input could not be submitted
fifo.notwritable: The interaction pipe is temporarily unavailable for writing
fifo.readerclosed: The read end of the interaction pipe closed during the write
fifo.writetimeout: The interaction input was not fully written before the deadline

path.forbidden: The requested path or its resolved location is in a restricted directory (HTTP 520)
path.outside: The requested file path is outside the permitted working directory (HTTP 520)
path.resolvedoutside: The resolved file path is outside the permitted working directory (HTTP 520)
